They do much better now, which is awesome! My parents struggled with communication. My mom would pick the wrong time to talk to my dad, he wouldn't be able to deal with whatever she needed right then, she'd get annoyed and nag him, he'd get mad, you get the picture. Or he would get annoyed and then cut off his nose to spite his face. They too have gotten better over the years. So when he and I got married, neither of us saw the point of bickering and acting like bratty kids over petty things like leaving the toilet seat up, the temperature of the thermostat, leaving dirty clothes on the floor, etc. What's the point? What we are learning to do, more me than him really, is when something is genuinely nagging at us, to say something calmly and clearly rather than sitting there in a steaming pile of resentment. And we also went through a phase of learning how to better guard the boundaries of this relationship - again, more me than him. It has made a vast difference. If you can be self-aware you will have fewer things to apologize to your spouse for and fewer things to fight about, and fewer things to resent. We have cultivated our friendship over the years as well. He is absolutely smitten with me and i adore him.
